chapter_title: Concerning the Three Images that are in the righte
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Three States Within the Regenerating Person

---

**¶2:** Three states of life exist within the person undergoing regeneration.

**¶3:** The first is the celestial-spiritual state, which is the regenerated will and understanding — that which Divine Wisdom forms within the interior mind; and it flows inward and dwells there as the inmost principle of life.

**¶4:** The second state is the residue and remnant of this regenerated understanding: the rational-natural state that remains bound within the sensual nature, even as the unregenerate proprium [GAP-1: has persisted since the] ages of this rational-natural state.

**¶5:** The third is the sensual-corporeal state [GAP-2: REVIEW which is] adjoined to all the others as the outermost degree.

**¶6:** These three states [GAP-3: constitute the whole person] entirely. When it will [GAP-4: be elevated] through the appropriation of goods and truths — if it shall descend [GAP-5: it passes] down into the sensual-corporeal state. [GAP-6: REVIEW And] the sensual-corporeal degree, [GAP-7: REVIEW which] is within it, shall put off that outermost nature and transfer it into the [GAP-8: rational-natural] state. [GAP-9: And] again it ascends and descends to the [GAP-10: celestial-spiritual] state; it shall put off the rational-natural elements belonging to the adversarial evils, which [GAP-11: are] wrath from self-love. The concupiscence [GAP-12: is also separated] with it.

**¶7:** Then shall Divine Truth in its feminine receptive form come forth and reveal the celestial-spiritual state that is [GAP-13: REVIEW present] within, which [GAP-14: REVIEW is] the regenerated will and understanding. That Divine Truth serves as a guide through the successive degrees. She proceeds before, and the purified life is elevated toward the interiors above, and is received into this celestial-spiritual state. And she [GAP-15: REVIEW forms] it and invests it with the regenerated will and understanding within. It is confirmed and conjoined in all the faculties of this Divine Truth who is present and dwells within the regenerated will.

**¶8:** This, then, is how the living element of good and truth is purified and vivified — that which enters the natural mind of the righteous person from without through the providential ordering of various goods and truths appropriated from the world. The living good within shall be cleansed entirely each day, traversing these three states of the mind in succession.

**¶9:** It shall put off the sensual body, which does not belong to it, within the corporeal degree. It shall also put off the evil affections that do not belong to it — those that are commingled with it in the rational-natural degree: [GAP-16: namely] wrath and concupiscence and [GAP-17: bitter]-ness and folly and envy and contention; and all other false persuasions from evil that are not its own.

**¶10:** However, in [GAP-18: REVIEW the] celestial-spiritual state itself it shall truly live. It is Divine Truth in her feminine receptive form who invests the regenerated will and understanding, and who shall be called *the state of true life*.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Three images occur in the elect person.
The first is the spiritual image, which is the new man, which the Light Mind shall form in him; and it goes into him and dwells in him.
The second image is the remnant and remainder of the new man, which is the psychic image that is bound in the flesh, as the old man [has existed since the] times of this psychic image.
The other one is the corporeal image [that is] added to them all.

These three images [are in him] entirely. When it will [ ... ... ] through the nourishment of food. If it shall sink [ ... ... ] down to the corporeal image. [And] the corporeal, [that] is in it, shall divest itself of it and place it in the [psychic] image. [And] again it rises up and falls to the [spiritual] image; it shall divest itself of the psychical of the enemies, which [ ... ... ] anger. The lust [ ... ... ... ] with it.

Then shall a Light Virgin come and reveal the spiritual image that is [there], which [is] the new man. That Virgin acts as a guide. [She g]oes on before and it is extended to the heights above, and received into this spiritual image. And she [forms] it and adorns it with the new man [wi]thin. It is sealed with all the limbs of this Light Virgin who is present and dwells in the new man.

So, this is [h]ow this living limb shall be [puri]fied and live, the one that comes into the body of [the ri]ghteous one from without through the administration of food of various ki[nds], like this. The living soul shall be clea[n]sed entirely every [d]ay and traverse these three [im]a[ges].

So, it shall divest itself of the body, which is not its own, in the corporeal. It shall also divest itself of the souls that are not its own, these that are mixed with it in the psychical [image, which are] anger and desire and [bitter]-ness and foolishness and envy and strife; and these other wicked teachings that are not its own.
However, in [the] spiritual image itself it shall live. It is the Virgin of Light who robes the new man and who shall be cal[l]ed ‘the hour of life’.

fills.explanation: The psychic image retains the old man (unregenerate proprium) that has persisted since the earliest ages of this rational-natural state, paralleling Swedenborg's teaching that hereditary evil has existed from the beginning of the natural mind's formation.
The editor's "that is" correctly introduces the corporeal image as the outermost degree adjoined to the other two; the spiritual reading confirms "which is" as an equivalent relative clause.

The spiritual reading says these three states "constitute the whole person"; in the Kephalaia's natural register, the three images "are in him" entirely, describing how the three degrees comprise the whole elect person.
The editor's "And" is confirmed by the spiritual reading; it introduces the next sequential stage of the purification process at the corporeal degree.

The editor's "that" is confirmed as the relative pronoun introducing the clause about what is within the corporeal image; the spiritual reading's "which" is semantically identical in this construction.

The three-degree progression requires that what is divested from the corporeal image is placed into the next higher degree — the psychic (rational-natural) image — before ascending further to the spiritual.
The spiritual reading indicates a sequential connector "And" introducing the next stage of ascent from the psychic image to the spiritual image, continuing the progressive purification narrative.

Following the ascending three-degree progression (corporeal → psychic → spiritual), after being placed in the psychic image, the soul rises to the spiritual image, which is the inmost degree where the new man dwells.
The editor's "there" is confirmed; it indicates the spiritual image that is present/existing within, which the Light Virgin comes to reveal as the inmost state of the regenerated person.
The editor's "is" is confirmed as the copula identifying the spiritual image with the new man (regenerated will and understanding), consistent with the spiritual reading.

The spiritual reading indicates "forms" rather than the editor's "sculpts"; in Manichaean and Swedenborgian cosmology, divine feminine truth "forms" (plasse) the new man, paralleling how Divine Truth gives form to the regenerated will — "forms and adorns" being the standard paired actions of giving essential shape and investing with qualities.

The pattern throughout the chapter requires "image" after "psychical" (cf. "corporeal image," "spiritual image"), and the spiritual reading's "namely" indicates a relative clause connecting the psychical image to the catalog of evil affections that follows; "which are" introduces the list of anger, desire, bitterness, etc. as the souls mixed in that degree.

The partial word gap plus the suffix "-ness" forms "bitterness," confirmed by the spiritual reading; bitterness is a standard member of the catalog of evil affections (anger, desire, bitterness, foolishness, envy, strife) that must be divested in the psychical degree.

The editor's "the" is confirmed as the definite article before "spiritual image itself," consistent with the spiritual reading's reference to the celestial-spiritual state as the specific locus where true life dwells.

assessment: 6 restored, 1 already filled, 7 editorial reviewed (6 confirmed, 1 corrected), 4 unfilled gaps
